inventory.label: Rover geological instrument suite
inventory.stateSchema: Source owner schema, model definition separate from runtime
inventory.creationSource: Ship/rover default preset or Engineering Workbench slot swap
inventory.consumption: Instrument assembly; dry mass 62 kg; continuous model bus rating 360 W
inventory.inputs: Installed physical Workbench part ID and actual selected sensor command
inventory.outputs: Original rover real battery/mass/power-derived state; only permitted sensor subset: spectrometer, thermometer, barometer, magnetometer, radar, seismometer, sampler
inventory.controlMethod: Parked Engineering Workbench part change, then real Field Science instrument request
inventory.hardwarePreconditions: Correct existing rover chassis, slot, mounted instrument and science bus; unsupported sensors fail closed
inventory.safetyLimits: No synthetic science reading; finite power, acquisition duration, same-body operating geometry; T15 parked assembly guard
inventory.faultModes: Unsupported sensor type, disabled instrument load, brownout or non-landable world
inventory.fidelity: Seeded instrument physics retained; mode/availability and bus ratings are original owner-derived
inventory.userVisibleProof: Workbench installed part with T15 service event; actual Field Science denial/acceptance and correct energy
inventory.automatedTests: tests/equipment-t15.test.cjs, tests/equipment-t15-browser.py
inventory.remainingUnverified: Physical calibration and continuous multi-planet manual mission; not certification of scientific truth
